verification.evidence: chip-group: no errors and no warnings; every ARC prop present (className mapped to class).

gaps: Phase 1 still-state: chips render at their resting end-state (check in, label over, surface tinted) with no layout-spring travel; the overflow folds instantly with no height morph; the +N text swaps without the roll; revealed chips appear without stagger. Phase 2 wires the shared-layout springs, width-lag edge follow, HeightFrame morph, text roll, stagger, and check draw.

No Radix or bits-ui primitive exists for this composition (ARC source uses motion LayoutGroup, not a Radix primitive), so the group is a custom port of ARC behaviour: roving tabindex, arrow/Home/End navigation, pinned overflow selection, and the MoreChip are preserved 1:1 minus motion.

LayoutGroup/AnimatePresence dropped (no exiting elements, so no AnimatePresence exit semantics to preserve); useWidthLag/HeightFrame/Swap helpers dropped with their ResizeObserver/motion machinery — data-selected CSS selectors carry the resting visuals.
React-only className dropped in favour of Svelte class. onValueChange is optional when using bind:value (ARC required it); value otherwise stays purely controlled as in ARC.
No icon dependency: the check is inline SVG per ARC.
